in_sanskrit.name: Bimbisaar
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has a brilliant intellect, learned and wise

in_marathi.name: Bimbisaar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Luminescent, Shining, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bimbisaar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'bimba' (luminescent, shining, radiant) and 'saar' (head, leader), Bimbisaar refers to a wise and brilliant leader. In Hindu mythology, Bimbisaar is the name of a wise and powerful king who ruled over the celestial beings.
